messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: pool=dedicated-rsv-7 (us-east-1) at 97% GPU utilization; queue depth +12,300 in last 10m. Autoscaler attempted scale to 18 nodes but failed due to soft cap (account-level limit). Affected tenants: Hightower (enterprise), OriMed (enterprise). Paging oncall @Maya. runbook: reserved-pool-backpressure.md link=https://internal.redwood/rr/1234

Maya: on it. acked pager, jumping on bridge. quick question — is autoscaler hitting a hard cap or quota?

Jamal: getting the graphs now. looks like two noisy sessions from a single tenant spiked token generation (long-lived streams). per-tenant queue: Hightower ~6.8k, OriMed ~3.1k, shared-best-effort ~2.4k.

Eli: autoscaler logs show "scale_blocked: account_quota_limit_reached" at 4897654200. we have a soft cap set on dedicated nodes of 18 (org-level). ops-bot: can we request emergency soft cap bump?

ops-bot: ran: `rbx admin quotas get --org-id rwd-tenant-42` output: `dedicated_nodes_limit: 18, current_nodes: 16`. submitted emergency quota request to infra for +6 nodes (ticket #INC-7892). ETA unknown.

Simone: we should apply mitigation first — throttle non-enterprise tenants and evict idle/noisy sessions. proposing immediate policy: set route-level concurrency cap and prefix-kv cache bypass for Hightower heavy sessions. agree?

Maya: yes. Jamal / Eli, can you put a temporary throttle at the pool ingress? Something like:

```
POST /admin/pools/dedicated-rsv-7/throttle
{ "mode": "per-tenant", "tenant": "*non_enterprise", "rate_limit_rps": 50, "reason": "emergency backpressure" }
```

Jamal: applying now. patching ingress rule — will log results. :wrench:

sre-ops: note — evicting long-running sessions may cause client reconnects; we should notify customers first. Aria, can you spin up a quick CS DM for Hightower & OriMed?

Aria: on it. sending message to Hightower support channel now: "We’re seeing degraded throughput due to reserved pool pressure; engineers are investigating and may apply temporary throttles. We’ll post ETA + bridge in 5m." pinging OriMed as well.

ops-bot: throttle rule applied to non-enterprise tenants. immediate effect: shared-best-effort queue decreased from 2.4k -> 600 within 90s.

Eli: submitted manual scale API call as emergency fallback: 
```
POST /internal/pools/scale
{ "pool": "dedicated-rsv-7", "target_nodes": 22, "reason": "incident 4897654321 - queue surge" }
```
Response: `accepted` (queued). pending quota approval.

Jamal: identified two long-running sessions from a single Hightower API key spiking KV cache misses — opening a targeted eviction for those sessions to reduce pressure.

Maya: please do a targeted eviction rather than broad evictions. avoid customer-impact where possible. Jamal, run eviction and post the session ids + short rationale.

Jamal: evicted sessions: session-7f3a and session-7f3b. immediate reduction: Hightower queue -1.9k. posting logs: 
```
[evict] session-7f3a pid=8421 owner=Hightower duration=2h actions=streaming tok/s=120
[evict] session-7f3b pid=8422 owner=Hightower duration=1.6h actions=streaming tok/s=95
```

Simone: good. next step — enable model-variant fallback for Hightower to q8_0 quantized for 60m to lower per-token GPU utilization. can we flip via rollout?

Eli: flipping rollout for Hightower to q8_0 now via console API. `rollout.create(tenant=Hightower, model_variant=q8_0, timeout=3600)` -> success. expect ~25-30% GPU savings per request.

bridge-lead-bot: created incident bridge https://bridge.redwood/bridges/BR-4897654321 with Hightower CS + SRE + Infra. joining in 30s.

Maya: status update — throttles applied, targeted evictions done, model fallback applied for Hightower. queue depth dropped from +12.3k -> +3.2k in 6m. autoscaler request pending. continuing to monitor. next update in 5m or on new material change.

Ryan: quick ask — can we temporarily reassign 2 reserved GPUs from non-critical tenants (internal dev reservations) to this pool? that would avoid customer impact while infra approves quota bump.

Simone: I can reassign 2 if ops approve. ops-bot: executing internal reservation reassign: `reservations.move --from dev-resv-4 --to dedicated-rsv-7 --count 2`

ops-bot: move completed; pool nodes +2 applied immediate. total nodes now 18 (from 16). queue down further to 1.6k. :thumbsup:

Aria: Hightower updated in channel; they acknowledge degraded throughput but appreciate proactive measures. OriMed onhold for now; waiting to see if scale completes.

Maya: good work team. open action items: (1) infra to approve quota +6 (INC-7892), (2) monitor bridge and queue for 30m, (3) prepare rollback plan for model fallback and throttles. I’ll update execs after next bridge sync.

sre-ops: logging timeline and actions to postmortem draft. tagging required owners: Jamal (evictions), Eli (scale), Simone (reservation moves), Aria (customer comms).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity=high -> downgraded to moderate as queue stabilizes. last recorded queue=1,600. next automated update in 10m.

Maya: closing initial pager window; keeping bridge open. will call for full postmortem if autoscaler limit is root cause and quota change required permanently. :eyes:
